fields.description: Mudon Al Ranim 7 is a townhouse release within Dubai Properties’ Mudon community in Dubailand. Its three- and four-bedroom homes include family-room variants with an additional upper level. The original launch is sold out at developer level; historical prices and delivery estimates need to be separated from today’s resale position.

reviewCoverage.identity: Dubai Properties phase 7, independently identified by own launch price document; not phases 5,6 or 8.
reviewCoverage.location: Own project page and phase 7 factsheet place it in Mudon, Dubailand. No guessed coordinates.
reviewCoverage.residences: Three- and four-bedroom townhouses, with family-room variants.
reviewCoverage.areas: All six visible numerical panels on own floor-plan pages 3–8 inspected. Brochure embeds the same drawings; hidden text includes stale phases 5 & 6 labels and different conversions. Visible current panels used.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Shared Mudon Al Ranim facilities distinguished from private home inclusions.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Historical phase 7 sheet AED 2.49 m/2.98 m preferred over conflicting AED 2.06 m web copy; current developer navigation marks phase 7 Sold Out.
reviewCoverage.payment: Own sheet explicitly PHASE 7 despite filename containing 5. Ten dated stages total 100; original calendar retained as historical.
reviewCoverage.handover: September 2026 was an estimate and is now past. Latest accessible developer progress remains dated March 2026; no independently verified current completion certificate or key-handover confirmation.
reviewCoverage.documents: Own 23-page brochure,10-page plans,1-page payment,26-page launch presentation and 2-page factsheet retrieved; numerical plans and payment visually checked. Combined overlapping community/plan document derivation 75 words reserved.

overview: The developer currently marks this phase sold out. An individual resale enquiry needs its own availability, payment balance and handover checks.
research.locationNote: Within Mudon in Dubailand, Dubai. Confirm the selected plot’s access and travel requirements before arranging a viewing.
research.priceLabel: Historical phase 7 launch guide · sold out at developer
research.priceNote: The phase 7 price sheet gives three-bedroom homes from AED 2.49m and four-bedroom homes from AED 2.98m. The current project webpage retains AED 2.06m in its overview, conflicting with the explicitly labelled phase 7 launch documents. Neither figure establishes a currently available unit or resale valuation.
research.paymentNote: This is the original 60/40 calendar, not a newly offered plan. All stated instalment dates have passed. Bayut instead publishes a 50% handover schedule; it is not substituted for the phase-specific developer sheet. Obtain a unit statement and contract before considering an assignment or resale.
research.handoverNote: September 2026 is the launch sheet’s estimated completion, not proof of delivery. The developer’s Q1 2026 update records 89.64% internal progress on 10 March 2026 and cites 81% RERA progress on 27 January 2026. Those dated measurements cannot establish completion as of 31 October 2026. Bayut still describes an off-plan project with Q3 2026 expected completion; obtain direct confirmation of the selected home’s current status.
